discription: A warm, evolving pad sound using a pulse wave with subtle width modulation and a resonant low-pass filter, suitable for ambient textures.
code: { arg out=0, freq=80, amp=0.1, gate=1, pulseWidth=0.5, filterCutoff=1200, rq=0.5;    var sig;    var env = EnvGen.ar(        Env.adsr(0.5, 2.0, 0.7, 5.0, curve: -4),        gate: gate,        doneAction: 2    );    var pwm = LFTri.kr(0.1).range(0.1, 0.9);    sig = Pulse.ar(freq, pulseWidth * pwm);    sig = RLPF.ar(sig, filterCutoff, rq);    sig = sig * amp * env;    Out.ar(out, sig ! 2);}
